items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: a friend of mine, his name was James Russell

ctx.x: I saw something where it said you were referred to as the Amazing June Gardner.

Yeah a friend of mine, his name was James Russell, they called him Stinky. That was a title that he put on me. We used to give concerts with the big bands. And he used to say, man I need a title in front of your name. I'm going to start calling you the Amazing. So that and then I had an album that was out many years ago on NOLA Records. And it was Gentleman June Gardner because a lot of the time people would say, I would give my name to guys. Like you said, June let me your number. And their wives would find my…
So maybe June was a woman? Yeah.
